purpose: Painted material textures for destructible Modern terrain, not DOS fidelity references.
prompts: Use case: game texture asset. Create one high-detail painterly sandstone CLIFF FACE MATERIAL TEXTURE for a sophisticated side-view 2D artillery game. Landscape 3:2 canvas, edge to edge uninterrupted rock, an orthographic vertical geological section, no perspective camera. Beautiful illustrated game art matching a premium hand-painted desert canyon concept. Warm terracotta, muted rust, burnt sienna, ochre and narrow pale golden sedimentary bands, not orange neon. Long irregular sedimentary shelves at multiple scales: large weathered rock masses, thin wavy strata, broken small angular plates, hairline cracks and delicate mineral grain. Broad asymmetric interlocking jagged rock faces, shallow ledges catching warm upper-left sunlight, dark narrow crevices beneath projecting layers, cooler muted violet-brown shadows on recessed/right-facing surfaces. Natural erosion and layered geology, not brickwork, not cobblestone, not a regular polygon mosaic, not evenly spaced stripes. Keep medium values and strong sculpted relief without black holes. Fine painterly detail crisp enough to display at 1:1 game pixels, not photorealistic, not vector, not noisy. Everything is rock face; no sky, no horizon, no ground plane, no terrain silhouette, no isolated boulders, no objects, plants, text, border, vignette or lighting gradient. All four edges show continuation of geology and match in palette/detail density for texture repeating. No single dominant focal point. This is a production material to clip inside arbitrary destructible terrain shapes, NOT a gameplay screenshot or landscape.

Use case: game texture asset. Create one high-detail painterly ALPINE GRANITE CLIFF FACE MATERIAL TEXTURE for a sophisticated side-view 2D artillery game. Landscape 3:2 canvas, edge to edge uninterrupted rock, orthographic vertical geological section, no perspective camera. Beautiful restrained illustrated game art matching a premium hand-painted alpine mountain concept. Slate grey, cool blue-grey, warm stone highlights and subtle muted mineral veins. Angular fractured granite geology: interlocking broad diagonal rock faces at multiple scales, long irregular fault seams, thin fissures, small shattered rock facets and fine mineral grain. Planes catch upper-left daylight; recessed/right-facing faces have cooler deep grey shadows. Large coherent faceted outcrops with fine detail, avoid round cobblestones, regular polygon mosaic or brick rows. Medium-light values, sculpted painterly relief, never pitch black. Fine crisp brushwork suitable at game resolution, not photorealism, not vector art. Everything is rock face; no sky, horizon, ground plane, terrain silhouette, isolated boulders, snow, moss, plants, objects, text, border or vignette. All four edges continue the same geology and match in palette/detail density for repeating. No dominant focal point. This is a production material to clip inside arbitrary destructible terrain shapes, NOT a gameplay screenshot or landscape.
